calendar.note: Bi-monthly VAT returns and payment are due on the 19th of the month after each period (the 23rd through ROS; the vault uses the 23rd). Preliminary tax for a year and the balance for the year before are due on 31 October, extended to mid-November through ROS (the vault uses 30 November).

workdays.note: Not verified whether deadlines here move off weekends and holidays. Kyros shows the last working day on or before the legal date, so paying on it is always in time, and keeps the reserve locked until the next working day after it.

prepayment.note: Preliminary tax by 31 October: at least 100% of last year's tax (or 90% of this year's, or 105% of the year before last by direct debit) avoids interest.

notes: The special 4.8% rate for livestock is left out: no preset uses it and the European Commission's TEDB does not list it among Ireland's rates.
Rates: 23% standard, 13.5% reduced, 9% second reduced (since 1 July 2026 also restaurant and catering food and hairdressing).
